description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Reveillark, adding {C}{C}.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Reveillark.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Activated Sleeper, adding {C}{C}.
When Activated Sleeper dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Reveillark.
Repeat from step 3.
